correctness.rationale: The actual package establishes a primitive rank-two integral vanishing lattice from H1(fiber)/<vanishing>=H1(total)=Z2, its reduction a two-dimensional isotropic L in H1(genus2;F3), and four nonzero transvections from the four nonseparating vanishing cycles. Source Theorem B gives intersection divisibility and full product relation. In a symplectic splitting L plus dual, T_v=I+N_v, N_vN_w=0, so group is additive span of vv^t. Independent exact enumeration of all 35 four-element multisets of four F3 projective lines gives unique zero-sum multiset consisting of all four directions. The four rank-one symmetric forms span all 27 Sym2(F3) matrices. A second independent primary source gives integer cycles whose six pairings are 3,-3,-3,3,-3,6 and whose reductions have relative coordinates (1,0),(0,1),(2,2),(1,2), confirming the four distinct isotropic lines. The result is a theorem for the specified degree-3 fibration only; no finite-test inference to a broader system.
residual_risks: Block convention depends on an adapted symplectic splitting: abstract image is defined up to conjugacy.
The package does not determine integral Sp4(Z) image or mapping-class image; the verified group is mod3 first-homology only.

value.rationale: The image of a distinguished minimal genus-two (4,3) Xiao Lefschetz fibration under its first nontrivial mod-3 congruence representation is a canonical finite arithmetic monodromy invariant. Establishing that it is the entire Lagrangian 3-dimensional unipotent group rather than merely some commuting subgroup, and identifying exactly four projective local directions, is a complete structural classification for this concrete fibration and a reusable datum for congruence-cover and factorization comparisons. The short finite-linear-algebra derivation and prior availability of all four integral vectors reduce its methodological and priority novelty; its value is the precise organized image classification, not a broad topological breakthrough.
residual_risks: The invariant is an extracted consequence of published generators and may be too incremental for some venues, but it is not an arbitrary unrelated numerical slice.

limitations: Only mod-3 homological image; not integral image or mapping-class kernel.
No mathematical novelty certification beyond best-of-knowledge; closest antecedent gives all local generators.
No original repository changes or external publication.
